layer_1_attention.name: Attention follow-up record
layer_1_attention.actual: Attention stores status, freshness, seen, reason, next_action, references, policy and execution observations; human actions advance its revision and append an event plus request receipt.
layer_1_attention.boundary: next_action is a recorded follow-up description; it is not a timer, scheduler, Matter decision or Core obligation.

layer_2_matter.name: Matter formal state and event history
layer_2_matter.actual: Matter owns version, source membership, candidates, artifacts, decisions and obligations. B0 persists state/audit; explicit B1 mode records typed events and can rebuild projections.
layer_2_matter.boundary: attention_event is not the B1 event table; acceptance is a trusted human/Core action, not a visible UI badge or model signal.

layer_3_model_context.name: Bounded Model Context projection
layer_3_model_context.actual: compileWorkContext emits schemaVersion 2 metadata for Matter, active Artifact identity/basis, source refs and pending candidates, with explicit omissions and a 24,000-character budget.
layer_3_model_context.boundary: basis.current describes input applicability; Context is a read projection and does not grant permission, acceptance or authority.

terminology_questions_for_main: 是否把三层 demo 标成 Attention → Matter → Context，还是把 Event Log 作为 Matter 层的时间轴子视图？
是否在视觉上明确区分 Attention next_action 与 Matter obligation，避免同用“待办/义务”造成权威混淆？
是否把 B1 event replay 作为可选解释视图，而不暗示当前所有 Host 都运行 B1？
